ui.intro: Learn to type without looking, one group of keys at a time. Each lesson opens when the one before it is mastered: 25 wpm at 95% accuracy over 30 words or more. Lessons earn XP, and count towards an XP daily goal.

ui.keyboard_needed: Lessons need a real keyboard: connect one (bluetooth or usb) and press any key. Tests and games work with the on-screen one.
ui.handoff_intro: You know every key now. Keep going on the typing page: timed tests and quotes build speed, and Kalibre starts noticing the mistakes you make most, so drills can work on them.

learn_sums.mental_arithmetic_the_accountant_s: Mental arithmetic, the accountant’s way: a sum appears, you work it out and type the answer on the pad, and press enter. You’re marked on the answer and how long it took. Three right in a row and the sums get harder; two wrong and they ease off. Every answer is exact to the penny.

learn_tenkey.amounts_arrive_one_to_a: Amounts arrive one to a line, like a tape. Type each one on the number pad and end it with the key shown after it: enter, or an operator. The tape moves on after a mistake, so keep going; backspace corrects the entry you are on. You’re scored in keystrokes per hour.

learn_till.customers_queue_at_your_till: Customers queue at your till. Each has paid with a note: work out their change, type it on the pad and press enter. Every customer’s patience runs down while they wait, so quick and right serves them and the next steps up. A wrong answer costs some of their patience, and when three have walked out, the till closes. The change is always exact to the penny.
